title: React v2 remaining screens: Dashboard, History, Problems Center, Surface Map, Packs, Evidence Replay, Custom CVE Library, Research
goal: Build the 8 remaining screens for React v2. REQUIRES backlog-268, 269, 270, 271, 272, 273. Each screen is a separate file in src/components/screens/. (1) DASHBOARD (src/components/screens/Dashboard.tsx): Five metric cards at top: Portfolio (engagement count), Active Tasks (running task count), Portfolio Risk (exposure score), Open Problems (open finding count), Reports (report count). 'FIRST RUN' section when no engagements exist: three steps 'Connect ChatGPT' / 'Create engagement' / 'Run first scan'. Quick Actions section: 4 large buttons (New Mission → /intake, Open Problems → /problems, Reports → /reports, Mission Control → /mission-control). All data from GET /api/v1/dashboard. (2) HISTORY (src/components/screens/History.tsx): Table of all runs across engagements. Columns: date, engagement, profile, status, findings (critical/high/medium), duration. Filters: date range, engagement, status. Clicking a row selects the run and navigates to /mission-control. Comparison: select two rows → 'Compare' button → shows delta panel (N new findings, N resolved, severity changes). Data from GET /api/v1/runs with limit/offset and filter params. (3) PROBLEMS CENTER (src/components/screens/ProblemsCenter.tsx): Cross-engagement finding lifecycle view. Stats bar: Open Critical, Open High, Visible count, All Findings count, Avg Resolve Time, Resolved This Week. Filter bar: engagement, severity, status, assignee, age, methodology. Finding rows showing: severity dot, title, engagement name, target, age, status badge. Bulk actions: select multiple → 'Bulk assign', 'Bulk retest', 'Bulk resolve'. Recently resolved section at bottom. Data from GET /api/v1/problems. (4) SURFACE MAP (src/components/screens/SurfaceMap.tsx): Three tabs: Assets, Attack Map, Insights. Assets tab: table of discovered hosts/endpoints from GET /api/v1/engagements/{id}/inventory/latest with filter and search. Each host shows: IP/hostname, OS, open ports, services, last seen. Attack Map tab: SVG visualization of discovered hosts as nodes. Similar to existing Cinema but static — no animation. Position hosts in a grid layout with connections between related hosts. Findings bubble on top of affected host nodes (colored by severity). Insights tab: summary stats (host count, service count, finding count by host). (5) PACKS (src/components/screens/Packs.tsx): List of capability packs from GET /api/v1/packs. Each pack: name, version, status (deployed/staged/available), methodology tags. Deploy/Approve/Validate buttons. Pack detail expandable showing artifacts list. (6) EVIDENCE REPLAY (src/components/screens/EvidenceReplay.tsx): Run selector. On select: show all task executions with stdout/stderr in a terminal-style view. Each execution is a collapsible block: [tool icon] [target] [timestamp] [duration]. Expanded: full stdout text in monospace scrollable. Download button for each execution artifact. (7) CUSTOM CVE LIBRARY (src/components/screens/CustomCVELibrary.tsx): Table of custom vulnerability definitions. Add/edit/delete. Import from NVD/text. Export button. Each row: CVE ID, title, severity, affected products, scan template status. (8) RESEARCH (src/components/screens/Research.tsx): Three panels: CVE Template Generator (select CVE from threat-intel list → AI generates Nuclei YAML), Custom Script Ideas (text input → AI generates detection script), Research Proposals Log (all generated templates with status). All AI generation calls POST /api/v1/ai/research/generate-script or the threat-intel template generation endpoint.
